subject: English
passage: In many cultures, eye contact during conversation signals honesty and respect between people. Psychologist Dr. Chanthara Keovongsa and her team are programming a virtual assistant to maintain appropriate eye contact with users in order to enhance human-computer communication. The virtual assistant's avatar adjusts its gaze patterns and duration to better mimic natural human eye contact. The researchers want the avatar's eye contact to appear genuine because ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: it's simpler to program an avatar to maintain eye contact than it is to program an avatar to perform other types of social cues.
choices.B: people are less likely to use virtual assistants that don't have realistic facial expressions.
choices.C: natural eye contact may make people feel more respected and honest when interacting with virtual assistants.
choices.D: the avatar in the researchers' study may have applications other than communicating with humans.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The text says that eye contact signals honesty and respect, and that the researchers' goal is to "enhance human-computer communication." This suggests that they want the avatar's eye contact to appear genuine because they want users to feel respected and honest.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. This inference isn't supported. The text never discusses facial expressions of this avatar or any other virtual assistants, so there is no basis to make this inference.
